text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Meisho Doto in the hallway, 
looking awfully sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wah? I'm, I'm gonna fall... Eeeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hau, why is there a bucket here? A-And a 
mop too?! It's falling over... Ah, waaah, 
the w-windoooow~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was tripping and bumping into anything 
and everything. It seemed she was terribly 
sleep-deprived.
